carrier_name: Mutual of Omaha (United of Omaha Life Insurance Company)

must_contain: United of Omaha Life Insurance Company
any_of: Underwritten by United of Omaha Life Insurance Company

extraction_notes:
Multi-product Mutual of Omaha "Group Insurance Proposal" packet (Basic Life/AD&D, Vol Life/AD&D, STD, LTD, Dental, Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, Accident, Vision), each product on its own numbered section with header "Proposal for" / "Alternate" number. For LTD specifically: located in section titled "LONG-TERM DISABILITY INSURANCE" (page labeled "Long-Term Disability Insurance"). Only ONE class/plan (Class 1: All Eligible Employees) in this document - single flat rate. Benefit Summary table lists: Benefit Percentage (60%), Maximum Benefit ($6,000), Guarantee Issue ($6,000), Elimination Period (90 days), Accumulation Period, Zero Day Residual, Own Occ Definition, Benefit Duration (e.g. "RBD to SSNRA"), Integration, Pre-Existing Condition, Mental Disorders, Drug & Alcohol, Self-Reported/Specific Conditions limits, Minimum Benefit. Partial Disability table follows with Earnings Test %, Partial Disability Formula, Work Incentive - these are not part of flat-rate schema, ignore for extraction purposes beyond noting benefit_amount_formula/duration/elimination_period.

Cost Summary table (on the next page, titled "COST SUMMARY") has columns: Number of Lives, Covered Monthly Payroll, Monthly Rate (stated as "$X.XXX (Per $100 of Monthly Covered Payroll)"), Total Monthly Premium, Total Annual Premium - only one row labeled "LTD". This is the flat rate to extract (rate_per_unit = dollar amount before "(Per $100 of Monthly Covered Payroll)").

Participation Assumptions table (Minimum Participation %, Number of Eligible Employees, Contribution Structure - e.g. "Non-Contributory" = 100% employer paid, or "100% employee paid") appears above the Cost Summary and indicates contribution structure - use for employee_contribution_pct field.

Only 1 LTD plan/class present in this document - confirm no other LTD classes exist before concluding extraction. Other products in the packet (Basic Life/AD&D uses per-$1,000 rate, Voluntary Life uses age-banded rates, STD uses per-$10-of-weekly-benefit age-banded rates, Dental/Vision/Accident/Hospital Indemnity/Critical Illness use tiered enrollment rates) should be ignored when only LTD is requested. Document also contains a final "Requirements and Assumptions" section with SIC code, situs state, general proposal conditions - not product-specific data.
